resolutions.rationale: Made the institutional actor explicit as The Scottish Parliament in the passes-the-bill example, following the fixed Oxford institutional example context and distinguishing it from an unnamed particular Parliament.
Scoped sense 2 by system and context rather than making an unsupported comparative regional distribution claim: it applies where particular Parliaments are counted by general-election boundaries.
Qualified the dissolution statement specifically to the United Kingdom, matching fixed fact F-020 and avoiding cross-system overgeneralization.
